info.name: Apollo B7A6 Housing & Roommate Platform API
info.description:
Versioned backend API for the Housing & Roommate Platform (Node.js + TypeScript + Express + Prisma + Stripe).

Generated from docs/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.0.3).
The collection defaults to the deployed API. Change the "baseUrl" variable for local testing.
Demo admin: admin@housing.local / Admin1234!

Auth flows capture tokens automatically: the Auth folder scripts store accessToken and refreshToken
in the collection variables, so protected requests work without manual copying.
